title: Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts: Tenure and the Alcohol ID-Scan Outage Credit
content:
**Rule.** In an alcohol-procedure dispute on Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts, the outage credit is adjusted by the shopper's tenure, counted in calendar days from the account's first activation date to the decision: with 1095 days or more it is doubled; with 365 days up to 1094 days (one fewer than 1095) it is increased by half of itself, the half rounded up to a whole point; with less it is used as it stands.

The first activation date is the activation date recorded on the contractor account; the count ends on the day of the decision.

## Condition — adjustment — result (hypothetical credits)

| Tenure on the decision day | Adjustment | Outage credit of 3 points becomes | Outage credit of 4 points becomes |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1095 days or more | Doubled | 6 points | 8 points |
| 365 to 1094 days | Increased by half, the half rounded up | 5 points (half of 3 is 1.5, rounded up to 2) | 6 points |
| Under 365 days | Used as it stands | 3 points | 4 points |

With no outage credit, every tenure leaves it at nothing.

## Edges

- Exactly 1095 days: doubled. 1094 days: the half-increase.
- Exactly 365 days: the half-increase. 364 days: as it stands.
